---
title: Generates treemaps on hierarchical data
output: html_document
params:
  df_rdv:
    label: "Input dataframe"
    value: NA
  group_cols:
    label: "Vector of names of group columns in df_rdv; should be in order of hierarchy"
    value: NA
  size_col:
    label: "Name of column to use for count"
    value: NA
  stratify_by:
    label: "Name of column to use for main grouping (e.g. cohorts)"
    value: NULL
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
reticulate::py_run_string("import sys")
```

```{r results, echo = FALSE}

if (!is.null(params$df_rdv)) {
  ghdp_result <- driveanalytics::gen_hierarchical_data_plots(
    params$df_rdv,
    params$group_cols,
    params$size_col,
    params$stratify_by
    )
}

```

# Treemap visualising hierarchical data

```{r plot, echo = FALSE, out.width = '500pt', results = 'asis'}
if (!is.null(ghdp_result$plt)) {
  plotly::save_image(ghdp_result$plt, "diagnosis_groups_treemap.png")
  knitr::include_graphics("diagnosis_groups_treemap.png")
} else {
  cat("No treemaps found")
}
```
